scope: Incorporation control projection only. Resource/exploration/task/adaptor FSMs remain to compose.
default: REJECT_PRESERVE_DOMAIN_STATE; bounded audit may record rejection
qualification_assumptions: checks_supported includes applicability, currency and sufficiency under fixed criteria
gate_eligible_and_exclusive_admission is serialized with accepted revocations
safe_restoration_observed includes no unknown in-flight writes and preservation of foreign changes
fresh_authorization matches latest authority_epoch, task/candidate/base/operation and all validity conditions; it does not erase revocation history.
orthogonal_state: task_revoked is global task context, updated by global handler in all states.
fresh_incorporation_authorized is derived from a sufficient identified approval after the latest accepted revocation, not a stored unversioned boolean.
Global handler runs once before the applicable local revocation transition; it never starts another task.
limitations: No atomic multi-file update or liveness proved.

effects: Record accepted revocation in durable local sequence and advance authority_epoch.
Set task_revoked=true; invalidate fresh incorporation approvals from earlier epochs.
For INCORPORATING, stop new incorporation writes and enter RECOVERING; existing issued writes remain observed.
For READY enter WAIT_AUTHORIZATION. For other states preserve local control state and latch revocation; do not reject the global event.
global_handlers.limitations: Actual acceptance requires valid scope and durable admission; this is an abstract event already qualified externally.
